criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 3, 5 and 9 strong. 6 a small pale kit object in a void with streaked ground; 2 a rhombus on a carpet with a slashed channel band; 4 a plastic strap on a repeating decal; 7's 28 can't be counted.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one accent meaning, the declared cut at 7, three continuity devices working. 2's top-down look sits slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Numerals all trace and attributions are labelled, but the cover hook and document title give c3's 444-acre project tract to Brownsville's de-annexation, which no claim sizes.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Body, instruments, place, date and hour named and the right to be heard quoted. The Saturday vote is undated and attending is the only route named.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 4 turns, 7 turns to action, 9 closes. 8 is a grab bag and 6 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Reads as someone who knows the Valley. 7 ends on a redundant filler line.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat, but nos. 61 and 62 used a city limit sign, survey stakes and a parcel drawn to area within two weeks.

hard_fails.fail: an unverified fact presented as verified
hard_fails.where: slide 1 hook 'Brownsville let about 444 acres go.' and document_title.txt
hard_fails.evidence: No claim states the area Brownsville de-annexed. 444 is c3's description of Starbase's project site; c9, c14 and c16 give no acreage.

one_sentence_fix: Rewrite the cover hook and document title so the 444 acres belong to Starbase's notice and the de-annexation carries no acreage.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: small pale kit object in a black void, streaked ground
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: about 150 m at fov 12 so the unit fills half the width, proper ground, the seam behind the stack

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: rhombus on a carpet, slashed channel band
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: saltgrass and crust with a lit near-corner pool, riprap with lit stone and dark water reflecting the seam

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 28 can't be verified, chairs cropped and dais chairs add to the count
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: pull back and up so 28 sit inside the frame, dais chairs in shadow

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: plastic strap on a repeating crack decal
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: end grain, split edges, frayed ribbon, a second noise scale, contact grime
